query:
let scoped = BowerSecurity_CL
| where CollectorId == "bower-fw-20261101-111911-linux" and ApplicationName == "nftables-firewall"
    and ApplicationEnvironment == "validation" and EventType == "network_connection_denied"
| where TimeGenerated between (datetime(2026-11-01T13:38:25.787000+00:00) .. datetime(2026-11-01T13:43:37.787000+00:00));
let collapsed = scoped | summarize arg_min(ingestion_time(), *) by EventId;
print RawRows = toscalar(scoped | count), CollapsedRows = toscalar(collapsed | count),
    DistinctIds = toscalar(scoped | summarize count() by EventId | count)
